point: Etcimex operates large-scale sorting with 10,000+ tonnes/year and defined quality grades including 'K' (brand new) and 'A' (almost new) for highest value.
quote: "CREAM (K) Quality is the highest standard describing fashionable goods that were never or only rarely worn, frequently still with the label."

point: Etcimex guarantees top grades free of defects, ensuring proven quality for retail resale.
quote: "Goods of the “K”, “A” quality are free of pilling, holes or stains."

point: Second Hand Land sorts 100 tons/month into 'krém' (cream) grade: nearly unworn items often with original tags.
quote: "Nejkvalitnějším kouskům se říká „krém“, tam se dostane oblečení téměř nenošené, nebo dokonce ještě s visačkou."

point: Opatex processes 300-400 tons/month, indicating major supply capacity for branded goods.
quote: "Moravskou velkotřídírnou Opatex projde každý měsíc 300 až 400 tun."

quote: "We offer 1st quality, quality cream and outlet. We import goods from England, America and selected parts of Western Europe."

point: HEDA TOP LIMITED supplies only direct imports from England in original presses and bales, preserving brand integrity.
quote: "Only direct import from England - original presses and bales."

point: Obleceni-anglie.cz offers graded textiles including 'Cream' and 'Outlet' categories from UK sourcing.
quote: "Offering graded textiles, size packs, presses, jocks, Cream, Outlet."

point: Luantex emphasizes supplying goods that retailers can add great value to, indicating strong price/value ratio.
quote: "We will supply you with goods that you can add great value to when you sell them."

point: Etcimex provides wide selection of original designs and non-traditional sizes/styles to attract retail customers.
quote: "You will be able to offer your customers a wide selection of clothing of original designs."

point: Czech second-hand market boomed with sales tripling; charity shops report 'best quality and very good brands' from sorted donations.
quote: "We sell clothing of the best quality and very good brands due to the way we sort donated clothing."

point: Etcimex employs 250+ staff with established sorting and quality control system, ensuring consistent proven quality.

point: Czechia imports used clothing primarily from Germany, UK, Austria — key sources for premium outdoor/lifestyle brands.
quote: "Czechia imported Used Clothing primarily from: Germany ($5.74M), Slovakia ($3.91M), Bulgaria ($3.44M), United Kingdom ($2.61M), and Austria ($334k)."

point: Second Hand Land sorts into ~100 categories and 6-8 subcategories per type, enabling precise retail assortment planning.
quote: "Třídí se v šesti až osmi podkategoriích. Například kalhoty můžeme rozdělit na letní, zimní, tříčtvrteční, dámské, pánské nebo džíny."
